## 2. Abbhantaramātikā (Internal Matrix)

(1) Five aggregates. (2) Twelve bases. (3) Eighteen elements. (4) Four truths. (5) Twenty-two faculties. (6) Dependent origination. (7) Four foundations of mindfulness. (8) Four right efforts.
